argument: Eight unequal folds must read as one held sheet before they read as a parts inventory. Silhouette, staggered seams, negative gaps, and a restrained central spine must carry the composition without interface chrome.

With labels, readout, controls, hint, and prose hidden, the first view must leave v046's monolith, v047's islands, and v048's wash. It should read as a folded material object, not a route map, node field, or pressure gauge.
The visitor must hold two sides together and wait. Pointer, touch, keyboard, and the deterministic chord control must offer equivalent meaningful paths; no hover-only action may carry the work.

A single site and a short chord must remain geometry-neutral. A valid release must change actual fold outline, opening, crease, notch, and seam geometry; status, glow, and prose cannot substitute for produced form.
The pressure sites must stay exact while the sheet changes inside. If the work simply deforms the contacted edge, it repeats local pressure and the translation fails.
The first chord must lead from the left and the next from the right, with the rule visible as a different fold direction. Same-lead repetition must refuse rather than become a cosmetic mode switch.
Four internal faults must compound in one sheet. Lift must reconstruct the exact preceding geometry and release must return to the deterministic quiet seed.

Generated p5.js Canvas 2D folds, seams, gaps, fault arcs, and fixed pressure sites are the medium. No screenshot, imported illustration, external font, or decorative particle system may carry the work.

p5.brush is translated from pressure and directional field logic into a timed relational chord, then refused as surface vocabulary. No brush preset, watercolor, hatching, grain, source palette, source composition, source code, examples, or API surface is reproduced.

Delete v049 if one-sided or short pressure commits, the edge sites deform, fold change is only colour or readout, same-lead repetition commits, later folds reset, the blind sheet reads as another field or monolith, or exact lifting fails.
